tasks.instruction: Diagnostic only, do not modify any file. Find the source module(s) in this repo responsible for writing memory/.seal.json. Steps: 1) search_code for the literal string ".seal.json" across the repo; 2) search_code for identifiers like "seal", "writeSeal", "sealMemory", "seal.json" to locate the writer function; 3) read_file the relevant source file(s) to confirm the exact function name, what fields it writes (e.g. hash/checksum of memory contents, timestamp), and the precise line range of the write logic. Report: file path(s), function name(s), and line ranges for (a) where the seal file path is constructed, (b) where the seal contents (hash/metadata) are computed, (c) where the file is actually written to disk. Do not edit or create any files.

Diagnostic only, do not modify any file. Find the function(s) that detect an out-of-band modification to memory (i.e. recompute/compare against memory/.seal.json to detect drift), and every operation in the codebase that refuses to proceed when the seal has diverged. Steps: 1) search_code for terms like "seal", "diverge", "tamper", "checksum", "verifySeal", "checkSeal", "out-of-band" ; 2) read_file the matching source files to identify the exact detection function (name + file + line range); 3) trace all call sites of that detection function and identify each operation (command/method) that aborts or throws when a diverged seal is detected, with file path and line range for each refusal point. Report a list of every such refusing operation with citations. Do not edit or create any files.
